svg.title: Local meeting recorder pipeline
svg.desc: Microphone and system audio are routed through BlackHole into a .wav recording, which is transcribed locally with faster-whisper, then summarized locally with Ollama running Llama 3.2, all controlled by a macOS menu bar app.

text.style: fill:rgb(137, 135, 129);stroke:none;color:rgb(11, 11, 11);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"Anthropic Serif Variable", "Anthropic Serif", ui-serif, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start;dominant-baseline:auto

svg.text: macOS menu bar app — start / stop control
